name: Kyoudou Maeko
source:
A veteran teacher. Famous for getting rid of bullying as soon as she arrives, she is often calls upon by the public whenever there is a need to eradicate the bullies. But in fact, she punishes the bullies through sex, using her body and techniques, a thorough sexual guidance.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1224492]Getchu[/url]]
